caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure standing upright on a decorative pedestal. She is dressed in a long, flowing purple gown with a fitted bodice, puffed sleeves, and a wide sash tied at the waist. The gown appears to reach her ankles, covering nearly her entire body. She is wearing a small, blue hat with a ribbon, and her short, curly, reddish-brown hair is visible. Around her neck is a wide, blue choker that matches her hat and sash. She has on black gloves and is holding a closed parasol in her left hand, while her right hand is resting over her chest. The pedestal beneath her feet is stylized with a green and gold color scheme, featuring scroll-like decorative elements. The background is a plain, light beige color with no other objects or scenery. There is a small inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Victorian Lady Figurehead
